paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 33b: Ravina permitted him to put beer into it, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital paragraph of Avodah Zarah 33b explicitly names Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yitzchak and says that Ravina permitted putting beer into it, with a singular referent. Only that bounded notice is translated here; no further events or legal conclusions from the paragraph are added.
